label: Google Drive: List Files
description: Lists the files a Google account can see (id, name, mime type), optionally filtered by a Drive query. One call reads one Drive page of at most `pageSize` files; to read the next, wire `nextPageToken` into the next call's `pageToken` while `hasMore` is true. A page over the 100 KB a wire carries fails the node, catchable by `_error`: lower `pageSize`.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Needs the read-all-of-Drive permission. Google classes it restricted, so it usually takes your own Google app rather than the shared one.

inputs.name: query
inputs.label: Query
inputs.description: Drive search query (the API's `q`). Empty lists everything visible.

inputs.name: pageSize
inputs.label: Page size
inputs.description: The most files one page holds (Drive may send fewer). A page that weighs more than the 100 KB a wire carries fails the node: lower this.

inputs.name: pageToken
inputs.label: Page token
inputs.description: Where this page starts: empty for the first page, else the `nextPageToken` the previous call handed out (Google's own token for its next page).

outputs.name: files
outputs.description: This page's files, {id, name, mimeType} each.

outputs.name: nextPageToken
outputs.description: Google's token for the next page, to wire into the next call's `pageToken`; empty after the last page.

outputs.name: hasMore
outputs.description: True when Google has a page after this one.
